comments.body:
@mtrmac 
> Is there a benefit to it? The other operations still call getDriver inside the lock, and making that inconsistent is a tiny bit ;risky. And I think it changes semantics of IgnoreIfExists if Store were ever called with different drivers.

You're right, I moved the getDriver back where it was, since there was no benefits in doing so.
Originally, I thought that it will save me the lock when validating arguments, but I was wrong, especially in case of `--ignore`.
@mtrmac I added a second commit for the Error struct you suggested. Let me know what you think, maybe you had a different idea in mind.
